Repo: https://github.com/eclipse-theia/theia

Cloud & Desktop

Not sure whether you need a web or desktop version or both?

Vendor Neutral

The Theia project is hosted at the Eclipse Foundation, a not-for-profit corporation, and is developed by a diverse community.

item.title: microsoft/Peregrine
item.author: emecas
item.description:
microsoft/Peregrine
Peregrine is a workload optimization platform for cloud query engines. The goal of Peregrine is three-fold: 1. make it easier to ingest and analyze query workload telemetry into a common engine-agnostic representation, 2. help developers to quickly build workload optimization applications to reduce overall costs and improve operational efficiency, and 3. providing better experience to the customers in the form of workload insights, actionable recommendations, and self-tuning capabilities.
Python repository by microsoft, created in 2019, with 23 stars and 1 forks. License: MIT. Archived by its owner. Starred on 2020-09-03.
https://github.com/microsoft/Peregrine
